colonyrank.settings.desc: In-game configuration for ColonyRank, including language and score multipliers. Quota: exactly 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.language.desc: Language used by in-game messages and Discord messages.
colonyrank.settings.populationMultiplier: Multiplier applied to the population score. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.buildingMultiplier.d: Multiplier applied to the building count score. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.averageBuildingLevel: Multiplier applied to the average building level score. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.claimedChunksMultipl: Multiplier applied to claimed chunks. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.overallHappinessMult: Multiplier applied to overall happiness. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
